title: Build A Long Sentence With Ahora (quiz-first)
voice_notes: Remix variant - reuses lesson-26-ahora-pero-stack audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: Now we have both halves. First: I want to cancel it. Then: but. Then: I do not want to cancel it now.

segments.word: I want to cancel it, but I don't want to cancel it now

segments.say: Quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora.
segments.word: Quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora
segments.phon: KYE-ro kan-se-LAR-lo, PE-ro no KYE-ro kan-se-LAR-lo a-O-ra

segments.say: And cancel it is cancelarlo. The lo goes at the end.
Good. You did not jump to the long sentence. You built it.

caption: Could you build the whole sentence before the reveal? Quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora.
